title: A $4 coffee can cost you $39 #Shorts
description:
Bank overdraft and NSF fees topped $12 billion in 2025 at the 20 largest banks, and about $35 per fee is typical. On debit card and ATM purchases, banks can't charge overdraft fees unless you opted in.

Sources: NCLC press release, 3 Jun 2026; CFPB newsroom, 17 Sep 2024; Banking Dive, 12 Dec 2024. The coffee example is illustrative.
Photos: coffee-rank and John Beans, CC BY 2.0.
Voiceover is AI-generated. Not sponsored. Not financial advice.
